title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of an additional laboratory-confirmed case of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection in Saudi Arabia.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of two additional laboratory-confirmed cases of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection in Saudi Arabia.

title: Human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus – update
summary: The National Health and Family Planning Commission, China notified WHO of an additional laboratory-confirmed case of human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus. This is the first new confirmed case of human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus since 29 May 2013.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of six additional laboratory-confirmed cases of infection with Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV).  Of these, two cases have been reported from Saudi Arabia  and four from the United Arab Emirates (UAE).

title: Poliovirus detected from environmental samples in Israel - update

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: The Ministry of Health (MoH) in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) has notified WHO of a laboratory-confirmed case of infection with Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) in the country.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: The Ministry of Health (MoH) in Saudi Arabia has announced an additional laboratory-confirmed case of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection in the country.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: The Ministry of Health (MoH) in Saudi Arabia has announced one additional laboratory-confirmed case and two deaths in previously confirmed cases of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection in Saudi Arabia.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: The Ministry of Health (MoH) in Saudi Arabia has announced two additional laboratory-confirmed cases and two deaths in previously confirmed cases of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection in Saudi Arabia.

title: Human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus – update
summary: The National Health and Family Planning Commission, China notified WHO of an additional retrospectively detected laboratory-confirmed case of human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus.
